name: Click Before Frames
description: iOS input-buffer stage control prototype with separate optional debugger. The Wave delay is derived from the All-ticks stage. Input interception remains disabled.

tick-rate-stage.name: Tick rate
tick-rate-stage.description: One slider selects the All-ticks stage: 2, 4, 8, 16, or OFF. Wave ticks are derived automatically as min(All ticks, 8). Four ticks = one frame at 60 FPS. This is an input-buffer delay stage, not native physics TPS.

debugger-enabled.name: Input buffer debugger
debugger-enabled.description: Separately enable/disable diagnostic log messages when the stage changes, including the derived Wave tick count. Does not change the selected stage or gameplay.
